hero.headline: We are Manuel Krüger and Marvin Deutz, a design and creative development duo based in Berlin. Together, we create brands and digital experiences that connect clarity in design with creativity in technology.
hero.contact:
Want to discuss a potential project?
Contact us at hi@deutzkrueger.de

services.title: Branding
services.bodyRich:
Visual identity is treated as a strategic asset. Comprehensive design systems are developed to translate company values into a coherent language, ensuring consistency across all physical and digital touchpoints.

- Logo Development
- Corporate Identity (CI)
- Design Systems & Guidelines
- Print & Editorial Design

services.title: Design
services.bodyRich:
The design process covers the full digital spectrum, from corporate websites to complex software applications. Logical structures are translated into intuitive interfaces, prioritizing clarity and usability to guide the user efficiently.

- UI/UX Design
- Web Design (Corporate & E-Commerce)
- App & Dashboard Interfaces
- Wireframing & Prototyping

services.title: Development
services.bodyRich:
Development is where strategy and aesthetics evolve into a high-performance product, building scalable solutions that bring the vision to life without compromise.

- Highly performant frontends
- E-Commerce, CMS & other backends
- Web Apps
- Software solutions beyond the web
